titulo.es: Arabia Saudí bombardea Yemen en la nueva andada de choques contra los hutíes
titulo.en: Yemen’s Houthis claim attacks on Aramco facilities in Riyadh

sintesis.es: Los enfrentamientos entre fuerzas gubernamentales yemeníes y los hutíes han dejado más de 800 muertos y 200.000 desplazados desde julio, según la OMS y las agencias de Naciones Unidas Leer
sintesis.en: Yemen’s Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for attacks in Riyadh, including on facilities belonging to Aramco, the world’s largest oil company. This follows reports from residents of flames and smoke rising from an oil facility on the outskirts of the Saudi capital. Meanwhile, the Houthis have accused Saudi Arabia of launching dozens of strikes on Sanaa, warning that they will continue to respond to any escalation with further escalation.

titulo.es: Brasil celebra elecciones presidenciales entre Lula da Silva y Flávio Bolsonaro en una contienda polarizada
titulo.en: Brazil holds presidential election between Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro in a polarized contest

sintesis.es: Brasil acude a las urnas el 4 de octubre en unas elecciones muy reñidas entre el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, que busca un cuarto mandato, y Flávio Bolsonaro, hijo del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, representando a la derecha. La campaña estuvo marcada por la polarización religiosa e ideológica, escándalos, la cancelación de un debate televisivo y la presión e injerencia percibida de la administración de Donald Trump en apoyo a sectores conservadores de la región. El resultado se considera clave para el futuro político de Brasil y el equilibrio geopolítico de América Latina.
sintesis.en: Brazil went to the polls on October 4 in a tightly contested election between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, seeking a fourth term, and Flávio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, representing the right. The campaign was marked by religious and ideological polarization, scandals, the cancellation of a televised debate, and perceived pressure from the Trump administration favoring conservative forces in the region. The outcome is seen as pivotal for Brazil's political future and Latin America's geopolitical balance.

titulo.es: Continúan los ataques israelíes en Gaza pese al alto el fuego, elevando a 1.400 los muertos palestinos
titulo.en: Israeli attacks persist in Gaza despite ceasefire, Palestinian death toll reaches 1,400

sintesis.es: Un año después del alto el fuego de octubre de 2025, los ataques israelíes continúan en Gaza, incluyendo uno reciente que mató a al menos cinco personas y otro que acabó con la vida del director de una organización humanitaria. Las autoridades sanitarias de Gaza cifran en 1.400 los palestinos muertos desde la entrada en vigor de la tregua. La población civil sigue sufriendo falta de agua potable, vivienda destruida y bloqueo a la reconstrucción, mientras organismos de la ONU reclaman retomar la solución de dos Estados.
sintesis.en: One year after the October 2025 ceasefire, Israeli strikes continue in Gaza, including a recent attack that killed at least five people and another that killed the director of a humanitarian organization. Gaza health authorities report 1,400 Palestinian deaths since the truce took effect. Civilians continue to face lack of clean water, destroyed housing, and blocked reconstruction, while UN bodies call for reviving the two-state solution.

titulo.es: Flydubai co-pilot used crash axe to attack captain, says UAE
titulo.en: Flydubai co-pilot used crash axe to attack captain, says UAE

sintesis.es: Attorney general says ‘terrorist attack’ was attempted by suspect who is said to have been barred from flying by Oman because of extremist views The co-pilot of flydubai flight FZ1073 used an axe to attempt to carry out a “terrorist attack” during the Israel-bound flight, the United ⁠Arab Emirates prosecutor general has said. Disaster was narrowly averted on Wednesday when passengers and crew intervened to stop the co-pilot’s attempt to take control of the plane, which had 182 people onboard and plunged 16,625ft in just over 30 seconds. The descent was so extreme that part of the rudder was ripped off.

titulo.es: Violentas protestas estudiantiles sacuden Francia por crisis educativa
titulo.en: Violent student protests shake France over education crisis

sintesis.es: Francia enfrenta una ola de protestas estudiantiles que se extiende desde institutos a universidades, motivada por la falta de profesores, recursos insuficientes y desigualdad entre centros educativos. Las movilizaciones han derivado en incendios, enfrentamientos con la policía y cierres de más de 1.000 escuelas, con cientos de detenidos y decenas de heridos, incluidos directores de institutos. El ministro de Educación ha accedido a reunirse con los sectores implicados mientras la tensión política crece, involucrando también a partidos como Francia Insumisa.
sintesis.en: France is facing a wave of student protests spreading from high schools to universities, driven by teacher shortages, insufficient resources, and inequality between schools. The demonstrations have led to fires, clashes with police, and the closure of over 1,000 schools, with hundreds arrested and dozens injured, including school principals. The Education Minister has agreed to meet with involved parties as political tension rises, also involving parties like France Insoumise.
